mcq.question: Inside `void f(std::string&& s)`, which overload does `category(s)` call?

options.A: The lvalue overload: a named rvalue reference is an lvalue

mcq.explanation: Anything with a name is an lvalue. Use `std::move(s)` to pass it on as an rvalue.

mcq.question: Why should a move constructor be `noexcept`?

options.A: Otherwise `std::vector` copies elements when it grows, to keep its exception guarantee
options.B: The compiler rejects moves that can throw
options.C: `noexcept` makes the move skip the destructor

mcq.explanation: `std::move_if_noexcept` only moves when that cannot throw. Otherwise reallocation copies.
